keys.swarm.aura_bloom_path_desc: Flowers bloom where you walk; walk back over one and it bursts in healing pollen.
keys.swarm.aura_bloom_path_ten: World Garden: the flowers burst on their own.
keys.swarm.aura_chime_pulse_desc: A chime rings: thin echo rings roll out one after another, and the last one stuns.
keys.swarm.aura_chime_pulse_ten: Grand Bell: a giant bell drops from the sky and stuns a wide area.
